findings.classification: introduced test evidence defect; file untracked relative to HEAD
findings.title: Missing baseline silently passes the baseline-integrity test
findings.evidence: oldSource falls back to current source when beforePath is absent. The named baseline-integrity test asserts only when oldSource !== source. Running the exact registered test block with equal sources registers one test and executes zero assertions.
findings.impact: A green test does not certify preservation of the pinned audited baseline on fresh checkouts. Differential incremental/full-current-render tests still execute and remain useful; no demonstrated false CPU/RSS win.
findings.suggestedAction: Report an explicit skip when the pinned baseline is unavailable, or require a fixed expected hash of the preserved renderer prefix without optional local state. No source edited.

findings.classification: new test copies an inherited cleanup defect
findings.title: Browser launch failure bypasses loopback server cleanup
findings.evidence: startServer resolves before chromium.launch, and try/finally begins afterward. Exact new test callback with fake server and rejecting fake launch starts one server and closes zero. HEAD diff confirms this route-markup test is new; surrounding old tests already use this pattern.
findings.impact: Failed launch can retain a listening fixture server and keep the Node process alive. Similar inherited patterns exist in browser-page, settings onboarding/redesign, visual-polish, workspace-peek, passwords/enter-browser and sync/setup-browser. No actual server/browser was launched.
findings.suggestedAction: Register cleanup immediately after server creation, before awaiting browser launch; guard optional browser cleanup and keep independent cleanup steps robust.

findings.classification: inherited test harness cleanup defect; file unchanged relative to HEAD
findings.title: Provider startup failure is outside registered cleanup
findings.evidence: launch spawns Python then rejects on its ten-second readiness timeout without killing the child. The test registers t.after only after launch and token read succeed.
findings.impact: A child that stays alive without publishing readiness can outlive failed test startup; a missing token after startup can likewise bypass server cleanup. No production credentials involved in these dummy fixtures.
findings.suggestedAction: Make launch terminate and reap on failed readiness, then register fixture cleanup before token read. Static finding only; did not start a provider.
